ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 to L.561-59 and R.561-1 to R.561-51 of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), as amended; Décret n°2016-567 of 8 May 2016 on the register of beneficial owners; Article L.562-1 et seq. and L.760-1 et seq. implementing EU AML/CFT Directives (EU) 2015/849 and (EU) 2018/843.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Authenticated copy of each shareholder-UBO passport and of the proposed gérant (manager)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority, then certified by a notary or registrar in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the country of origin; if the country of origin is not a Hague member, legalization at the French Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and statutory documents (memorandum/articles) of any non-French corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or competent registrar of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization for non-Hague countries) and, where the corporate register is electronic, an apostilled certified extract from the registry

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution or notarized power of attorney authorizing the proposed SARL signatory to execute the incorporation deed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of the corporate shareholder or a local notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / consular legalization, and sworn translation into French by a registered translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank attestation of deposit of cash capital contributions (attestation de dépôt de fonds) issued solely for funded contributions
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French bank or foreign bank branch authorized to receive the capital deposit
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If the attesting bank is outside France, the attestation must be notarized and apostilled; otherwise original with the registry

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of each UBO against the French asset-freeze lists (DG Trésor), EU restrictive measures, UN Security Council consolidated lists, and FATF compliance indicators. OFAC screening is not statutory for a French SARL but is required contractually by TikTok Creator Payout and Wise B2B rails for USD clearing. A risk-based PEP check is governed by Article L.561-10 CMF; enhanced due diligence is mandatory for PEPs and for any UBO for whom the 25% threshold is reached through a trust or chain of legal persons.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (INPI, formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), with pre-check through the Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (via Infogreffe)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be written in Latin characters and capable of being entered in French public registers. A non-French script name must be accompanied by a faithful transliteration into the Latin alphabet; the name may not be misleading as to the legal form or activity and must not contravene French public policy or French law on distinctive signs.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the INPI or functional registry rejects the proposed name, the applicant may, within 1 month, submit a written 'recours administratif' to the INPI Formality Centre requesting re-examination with supporting evidence (prior registrations, trademark searches, judicial decisions). If the administrative re-examination is refused, the applicant may bring an action before the local Tribunal de commerce within two months. For ex officio objections based on conflict with a senior registered company name, the remedy is either a letter of consent from the earlier registrant or an opposition action for infringement. There is no statutory extension of the name-clearance window, and a fresh search must be run if incorporation is delayed beyond 30 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permitted for an SARL only where the domiciliation company is a legally registered 'société de domiciliation' maintaining a real office in France, physically receiving mail, and providing lease/presence documents for tax administration. For the TikTok MCN agency, pure mail-forwarding without a French operational manager is not recognized as an effective registered office and can result in refusal of the TVA registration and EU VAT MOSS profile.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 18 months; risk increases to 40% if the registered office is the personal home of the manager for more than two years or if the UBO jurisdiction is on a FATF enhanced-monitoring list.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI / Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (RNCS) registration fee for the SARL incorporation file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle) acting as the single filing gateway
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of 32.50 EUR plus ancillary fee of 8.50 EUR for RNCS registration (approx. USD)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory publication of the incorporation notice (avis de constitution) in a French legal gazette (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'annonces légales authorized by the Prefecture of the registered office department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Tariff set by Prefecture (arrêté préfectoral); Paris-Nord regional benchmark for a non-regulated SARL is 130–180 EUR (approx. USD)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: French avocat drafting of articles of association (statuts), UBO declaration and general AML evidence package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French barred attorney (avocat) retained for pre-incorporation compliance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market flat fee for a standard SARL without real-estate contributions (800–1,500 EUR)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization fees for foreign corporate/UBO documents including passports, registry extracts and powers of attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (issuing apostilles) and French Consulates for legalization
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Approximately 9.50 EUR per apostille (L. 2016-1187), plus local consular fee per document; budgeted for 4 documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year registered-office domiciliation contract with an approved commercial domiciliation company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Agréée commercial domiciliation provider in Paris
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of 90–140 EUR/month including mail handling and tax-administration access

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Opening of a French professional bank account and issuance of capital-deposit attestation if funds are deposited before incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French commercial bank (or branch authorized under the right-to-account procedure of Article L.561-35 CMF)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank administrative tariff for capital-deposit certificate; not regulated by statutory scale

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (France): Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (Société à Responsabilité Limitée formation and governance); Articles L.123-1 to L.123-38 and R.123-101 to R.123-118 (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés and central formalities); Law n°2019-486 (PACTE) Art. 13; EU Services Directive 2006/123/EC transposition.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce within the territorial jurisdiction of the registered office (Paris Commercial Court Registry for Paris), operating via the INPI Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS); INSEE assigns SIREN/SIRET.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de création d'entreprise (M0) filed electronically on the INPI guichet unique, together with the signed Statuts (Articles of Association) and the déclaration de conformité; registration evidenced by the extrait Kbis.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum legal capital €1 (Article L.223-2 Code de commerce) — no statutory minimum for the unregulated creator/MCN agency; capital must be fully subscribed. Cash contributions must be released at least 20% upon subscription (Article L.223-7) and the outstanding balance paid within 5 years; funds must be deposited in a blocked bank account (compte bloqué) with a French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations until the Kbis extract is obtained.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BE IT RESOLVED by the shareholders of the company in formation, acting under the French Code de commerce: (1) the Articles of Association, share subscriptions, and the schedule of contributions and preliminary expenses are approved and ratified; (2) the designated registered office is adopted for the company's full term; (3) [Name], holder of ID [No.], is appointed Gérant with full powers of management, representation and disposition within the corporate purpose; (4) the Gérant is authorized to open bank accounts, execute the declaration of conformity, and complete all filings with the INPI and the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce until the RCS registration and the Kbis extract are issued. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution and Optional Notarization of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders by private deed; Notaire of choice when a real-property contribution or donation is involved
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the French-language Statuts, including legal form (SARL), corporate purpose (ISIC 7310 creator multi-channel network and talent agency), share capital and release schedule, registered office, duration, fiscal year, identity and powers of the Gérant, and transfer/exit clauses. Each shareholder initializes every page and signs the last page; if the contribution includes real estate or is in kind, the deed of contribution must be notarized and a commissaire aux apports report is required.
required_dossiers: Valid national ID or passport of each shareholder
Proof of residential address (utility bill or equivalent)
Draft Articles of Association with capital, purpose and management clauses
Contribution report (rapport du commissaire aux apports) for in-kind contributions
Declaration of name availability (optionally checked with INPI/RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a deficiency is signalled (invalid object, insufficient capital release, missing notarization), adopt a corrective resolution, amend the Statuts by an extra-assembly decision, and resubmit before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocking Deposit of Cash Contributions and Delivery of the Bank Deposit Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution (bank) or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account (compte bloqué) in the company's name in formation using the mandate of the future Gérant; transfer the subscribed cash portions (at least 20% of each subscription, or 100% where the capital is less than €100); obtain the attestation de dépôt des fonds / certificat du dépositaire; upon registration the Gérant produces the Kbis to the bank to release funds.
required_dossiers: Mandate and identity documents of the future Gérant
Draft Statuts containing the capital schedule
Bank transfer or wire confirmation of the contributed funds
Beneficial-ownership statement of each shareholder (AML/KYC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the KYC file or the deposit certificate contains discrepancies, supplement the identity/beneficial-ownership evidence or instruct the bank to re-issue the attestation; replace the depositary institution if the recharge is refused.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Statutory Formation Notice in an Authorized Legal Announcements Journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized by the préfecture of the registered office jurisdiction
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the avis de constitution stating legal form (SARL), corporate name, share capital, registered office, corporate purpose, duration and Gérant; file the notice with the approved JAL and obtain the justificatif de parution; the notice must be published before or simultaneously with the RCS filing, and within one month of the statuts date.
required_dossiers: Avis text supplied to the selected JAL
Copy of the Statuts
Invoice/payment confirmation of the publication fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL refuses the announcement because of missing legal mentions, amend the text and re-submit; if the one-month deadline is exceeded, the capital resubscription situation is cured by a new deposit or a late-publication authorized and the registry is so informed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Central Filing of the Creation Dossier with the INPI Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) — operator of the guichet unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the national portal, complete the M0 electronic form, attach the series of supporting exhibits, and pay the statutory filing and registry fees. The guichet routes the dossier in one submission to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS registration), INSEE (SIREN/SIRET/APE), DGFiP (tax registration), and URSSAF/ACOSS (social enrollment).
required_dossiers: Completed M0 form (online)
Statuts signed, paginated and legalized (as applicable)
Deposit certificate of capital (attestation du dépositaire)
Proof of publication in a JAL
Déclaration de non-condamnation and identity of each Gérant
Proof of registered office occupancy (lease title, sublease, domiciliation agreement or ownership deed)
Mandate for the agent if filed by an authorized intermediary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is rejected or considered incomplete, remedy the notified irregularities online within 15 days (or 30 days where the public action is required); upon a formal refusal, file a claim before the President of the Commercial Court of the registered office jurisdiction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration and Issuance of the Extrait Kbis
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce du lieu du siège social (Paris Commercial Court Registry or competent territorial registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once transmitted by the guichet unique, the Registry verifies legal compliance of the Statuts and the managers' fitness; upon verification, the company is inscribed in the RCS, a SIREN, SIRET and APE code are automatically published by INSEE, and the official extrait Kbis is issued — this document is the conclusive evidence of the company's legal existence and activates its juridical personality.
required_dossiers: Complete dossier relayed by INPI guichet unique
Payment receipt of registry fee (frais de greffe)
Certified copy of the Statuts with conformity declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is refused, file a supplementary brief with the juge commis à la surveillance du registre or the President of the Commercial Court for judicial registration; in case of constructive silence exceeding the statutory deadline, compel the registry through the court registry office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Tax, Social and Bank Activation Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — Service des Impôts des Entreprises; URSSAF/ACOSS; SSI/CIPAV for the Gérant; professional bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the intra-community VAT number automatically notified by DGFiP (default corporate income tax (IS) regime for SARL); verify the SIRET; enroll the social scheme of the Gérant (assimilated salary scheme) and of any staff; activate the professional bank account by presenting the Kbis and the bank mandate; determine whether a statutory auditor is required (three-threshold test: balance sheet > €10M, revenue > €20M, headcount > 50, any 2 triggers apply); as the MCN agency activity is unregulated, no industrial license is required.
required_dossiers: Extrait Kbis
INSEE registration notification (SIREN/SIRET/APE)
VAT number communication from DGFiP
Gérant civil insurance policy (RC Pro) and employment declarations if applicable
Bank KYC and mandates signed by the Gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VAT number or the employer registration is delayed, direct communication to the local SIE or URSSAF unit to accelerate; if the social classification of the Gérant is disputed, request a formal determination (ruiling) from the competent social security body before the first contribution.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction régionale de l'économie, de l'emploi, du travail et des solidarités (DREETS Île-de-France) for office/service activities; DREAL for environmental control — no industrial licensing board is applicable to the creator agency scope
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no industrial operating license, no commercial patent, and no ICPE (installation classée pour la protection de l'environnement) authorization under the Code de l'environnement is required for an unregulated non-industrial online creator and MCN agency; compliance relies solely on ordinary administrative and employment formalities.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL) / Inspection des Installations Classées
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the activity is not an ICPE under Article L.511-1 and is not listed in the threshold nomenclature of Article R.511-9 of the Code de l'environnement; no environmental impact assessment or prior authorization is required for ordinary office/streaming operations, and no entry of the project exists in Annex to Article R.122-2.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office-only occupancy: non-industrial wastewater discharge subject to municipal sanitary regulations (Article L.1331-1 Code général des collectivités territoriales, administrative authorization above 25 m³/day); indoor air quality limits under Décret 2011-321 (formaldehyde ≤ 10 µg/m³, benzene ≤ 2 µg/m³, total VOCs ≤ 1 000 µg/m³); producer waste-sorting obligations under Articles L.541-1 et seq. (DEEE and office waste streams); no VOC, NOx or other industrial emissions thresholds apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate and periodic fire-safety visit by the commission de sécurité (Code de la construction et de l'habitation — 5th-category ERP when offices are open to third parties); workplace health and safety inspection under the Code du travail (Article L.4121-1), including the DUERP (single risk assessment document), evacuation rituals, first-aid devices, and ACMO designations; structural load and occupancy clearance confirmed by the registered office lease-owner's building maintenance file.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (SARL subject to Corporate Income Tax; territorial scope: French resident company taxed on worldwide profits; no tax-exempt zone for this entity)

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (TVA - Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée)

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), acting jointly with the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) for banking prudential supervision and AML/CTF enforcement; legal foundation is the French Code Monétaire et Financier Articles L151-1 to L165-5, supplemented by E.U. Regulation (EC) No 924/2009 on cross-border SEPA payments and E.U. Regulation (EU) 2015/847 on information accompanying funds transfers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a eurozone member and applies full convertibility of the euro on both current and capital account. Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union Articles 63-65 guarantee free movement of capital and payments with respect to third countries, subject only to E.U. sanctions, French FDI screening in defined sensitive sectors, and balance-of-payments statistical reporting. Profit remittance by an SARL is not blocked by exchange control: dividends, management fees, loan interest and liquidation proceeds may be transferred abroad without Banque de France prior authorization. A 30% withholding tax applies to outbound dividends to non-resident shareholders unless reduced under a tax treaty; that is an income-tax consequence rather than an FX prohibition. The MCN agency business (ISIC 7310 advertising / creator agency) is not a regulated sensitive sector for FDI purposes, although a screening confirmation should be filed if the French operation collects certain connection or data-identifying traffic that could fall under Article L151-3 CFM.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no export proceeds surrender requirement, no minimum mandatory conversion ratio, and no prescribed statutory repatriation timeline for receipts denominated in convertible foreign currencies. The euro being the national settlement currency, exporters may lawfully retain foreign-currency balances in E.U.-licensed bank accounts and may convert them at commercial conditions. The only operational discipline is statistical and declarative: cross-border financial relations with non-residents involving individually or cumulatively amounts equal to or greater than EUR 50,000 per calendar month must be captured by the bank and reported to the Banque de France through the MEDOC-BEBA balance-of-payments filings, and every cross-border payment order must carry the correct Banque de France transaction purpose code. Foreign-currency cash physically moved across French borders exceeds EUR 10,000 must be declared to customs, and payments routed through non-bank offshore channels could violate Article L561-15 CMF regarding the obligation to use an established intermediary for qualifying sums.

Capital Escrow Account plus Operational Multi-Currency Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: High for E.U.-authorized electronic money institutions passported into France under PSD2 single-licence rules; Low-to-Medium for offshore or non-E.U. digital EMIs. Wise B2B is viable because Wise's Belgian EMI licence is passported into France; nevertheless it must be treated as a secondary disbursement utility and cannot replace the mandatory French bank relationship for statutory capital deposits, tax domiciliation, or legal clearing accounts. An entirely offshore EMI without E.U./EEA authorization may not lawfully provide payment services to a French-resident SARL, and reliance on such a rail without ACPR notification would create a KYC and licensing exposure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a standard société à responsabilité limitée, the gérant must undergo personal identity verification under the French AML framework (Article L561-5 CMF). Tier-1 French commercial banks generally require at least one in-person appointment with the natural-person gérant, presentation of an original valid passport or E.U. identity card, original notarized or duly certified Articles of Association, original or recent Kbis extract, UBO declaration form, proof of physical office address, and confirmation of the economic purpose of foreign payment flows. Fully remote account opening is legally available under the PACTE Act and RGPD-compliant video-identification schemes, but it is typically accepted only by licensed neo-banks and EMIs; the ACPR-regulated Tier-1 banks usually combine a video call with an authenticated electronic signature and a physical mailing of the banking agreement. Remote opening is therefore permissible in theory but not unattended; the relationship manager must still obtain an examination of the customer's legal existence and beneficial ownership chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency TikTok/ByteDance creator monetization inflows with no conventional buyer-supplier invoice trail, triggering source-of-funds suspicion and 'online platform income without documentary basis' red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 1) TikTok Creator Payout account history and payout statements showing beneficial owner, platform gross revenue and settled amounts; 2) executed creator representation contracts listing commission percentages and period; 3) consolidated treasury ledger of expected payouts per settlement cycle; 4) commercial invoices issued by the SARL to each monetizing client with ISIC 7310 service descriptor; 5) UBO and corporate structure chart; 6) an annual or quarterly business plan forecasting payout volume and correspondent bank flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Global creator payouts routed to beneficiaries domiciled in jurisdictions perceived as high-risk, tax-haven or sanction-sensitive, causing automatic transaction block or enhanced due diligence escalation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Beneficiary creator KYC pack consisting of government-issued passport or identity card, proof of residence, verified creator profile, historical payout records, executed content-services agreement, tax status evidence for U.S. creators (Form W-8BEN/W-9) or E.U. VAT numbers, FATF-relevant source-of-funds explanation, and contractual undertakings that all creator payments are strictly platform-monetization compensation with no third-party pass-through intention.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting escalation classifying the MCN as elevated money-laundering risk because digital content creator flows can be coupled with cryptoassets, stablecoins, or unregulated micro-payment channels.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal treasury and compliance policy certified by the gérant confirming exclusive reliance on regulated traditional banking rails (SEPA/SWIFT), zero cryptoasset or stablecoin onboarding, and no use of grey digital wallets; implementation of transaction monitoring reports; external accountant's certification of AMLD4/5 alignment controls; a whitelist of approved payment rails including TikTok_Creator_Payout and Wise_B2B but excluding unregulated virtual-asset service providers; and an annual AML training record for the social-media operations team.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign-oriented revenue and almost no local French substance, provoking the bank's economic-connection objection and possible refusal under French market practice to open a full corporate account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: French operating substance file containing the French registered office lease or domiciliation contract, French SIREN/SIRET and VAT/GRE registration, French tax residency of the gérant, French creator payroll or French contractor agreements, local purchases showing French goods/services consumption, monthly French social-security declarations, evidence that strategic management decisions are taken in France, and historical French corporate income tax returns after first filing.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: At SARL formation the subscribed capital must be fully paid and deposited into a blocking account opened at a licensed French credit institution, before incorporation, or alternatively with a notaire or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations. A non-resident shareholder should transfer the funds via SWIFT MT103 for non-EUR or via SEPA Credit Transfer for EUR, using the Banque de France capmov purpose code for 'capital subscription / constitution of société', the SARL's SIREN/SIRET number, the block-account IBAN, and the shareholder's full corporate/individual legal name and address. The bank will not release the blocked funds until the RCS Kbis certificate is produced; the account is then converted into the operational account. Post-incorporation capital injections by foreign parents should be documented as a share capital increase authenticated before a notaire, while shareholder current-account funding must be covered by a formal compte courant d'associé agreement with arm's-length interest, subordination wording and repayment schedule to prevent recharacterization as hidden distribution. Individual cross-border flows of EUR 50,000 or above are captured automatically by the receiving French bank in the monthly MEDOC-BEBA declaration to the Banque de France; no prior FX authorization is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For E.E.A. creator payments the primary route is SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer using ISO 20022 pain.001 messages from the French operational account. For non-EEA creator payouts, disbursements must be executed by SWIFT MT103 through the bank's clearing network with full beneficiary name, account number, BIC/IBAN, address and precise payment narrative. Repetitive creator and media-purchasing disbursements should be batched via MT101 corporate payment instruction or a host-to-host ISO 20022 channel, allowing the bank to apply uniform compliance screening. TikTok_Creator_Payout rail should be reconciled daily and parked as platform receivables; Wise_B2B may be used for low-value rapid creator settle-outs only after being whitelisted by the primary bank's treasury desk. For trade-related procurement such as production, merchandise manufacture or large-scale ad-inventory contracts, conventional clearing instruments remain available and permissible: Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP600, standby letters of credit, and documentary collections; those instruments are viable but are economically appropriate only for high-criticality counterparties or cross-border campaigns exceeding the normal commercial clearing appetite.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD deliverable outright forward (change à terme) with a licensed French credit institution, based on documented TikTok advertising or USD creator revenue exposure.
Bought vanilla FX options on EUR/USD and EUR/CNH for premium-limited treasury cover of platform settlement volatility.
Cross-currency swap or FX swap used strictly against long-term intercompany liabilities where the capital injection is non-EUR, subject to EMIR clearing and transaction reporting thresholds.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (comptes annuels): balance sheet, profit and loss statement, annex, and management report, approved by the annual ordinary shareholders’ meeting and deposited with the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (registre du commerce et des sociétés, RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a standard 31-Dec year-end: shareholders’ meeting must approve accounts within 6 months (by 30 June); deposit with the Greffe within 1 month after approval and no later than 31 July. For other year-ends, approve within 6 months of closing and file within 1 month of approval.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing: administrative fine up to EUR 3,000 (EUR 1,000 per manager); possible court order to file under penalty payment; repeated default may trigger judicial action and risk of strike-off (radiation) from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale / déclaration de résultats), including forms 2058-A to 2058-G and the 2065-SD summary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Service des impôts des entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a 31-Dec fiscal year: file online by the second working day after 1 May (usually 3 May) of the following year. For other fiscal years: within 3 months after the closing of the financial year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty: 10% of assessed tax plus 0.20% per month late-payment interest; if omitted or inaccurate, additional 40% (or 80% in cases of detected tax evasion); may trigger control and recovery proceedings; no direct strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO and statutory register audit (control of the register of beneficial owners and the share ledger; submit a declarative update to the RCS only when a change has occurred)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company’s registered office (internal records); Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce upon any change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Perform the register audit within 30 days after the annual accounts approval (or within 30 days after the company anniversary date if the accounting period is irregular). If any beneficial-ownership or shareholding change is identified, file the updated declaration with the RCS within 30 days of the change event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-maintenance of the UBO register or failure to file within 30 days: fine up to EUR 15,000 per conviction; directors may be subject to a custodial sentence; company risk of administrative sanctions and reputational adverse registration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory for the SARL if it exceeds at least two of the three thresholds: balance-sheet total > EUR 4 million, turnover excl. VAT > EUR 8 million, average workforce > 50 employees; the auditor may also be appointed upon a shareholder request representing at least one-tenth of the capital.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, Code de commerce L123-13 to L123-28). IFRS is not permitted for individual SARL statutory accounts; consolidated group accounts, if prepared, follow IFRS as adopted in the EU.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not require an annual pro-forma refiling of beneficial-ownership data if no change has occurred. Management must annually verify the UBO register and underlying shareholding statements, record any variation, and file the updated beneficial-owners declaration with the RCS within 30 days of the event. The annual verification must be documented and retained.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (registre des associés / share-ledger)
Register of Directors (registre des décisions du gérant)
Minute Book (registre des assemblées générales et des décisions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 – USD 4,200 per year for a Paris/France registered-office and corporate compliance agent
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,500 – USD 18,000 per year when an audit is required; for small SARL without a statutory auditor, a voluntary limited review of accounts ranges from USD 2,500 to USD 6,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax rate (Impôt sur les Sociétés, effective for fiscal years opened on or after 1 January 2022); 15% reduced rate applies to the first EUR 42,000 of taxable profit for qualifying SMEs (turnover below EUR 10 million).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: JEI (Jeune Entreprise Innovante): 100% corporate tax exemption for the first profitable fiscal year and 50% exemption for the next four fiscal years for certified innovative companies; CIR (Crédit d'Impôt Recherche): 30% credit on eligible R&D expenses; reduced 15% SME bracket on first EUR 42,000; international headquarter status may be obtained by advance tax ruling for hub functions; no general-purpose tax holidays exist in France.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward (report en avant) with annual cap: EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000; carryback (report en arrière) limited to one fiscal year, capped at EUR 1,000,000, and converted into a refundable tax credit (Crédit d'Impôt pour Report en Arrière).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065-SD (Cerfa 15954) - corporate income tax return and summary of the 'liasse fiscale'; filed electronically via the EFI system (Echange de Formulaires Informatisés) on impots.gouv.fr professional portal or net-entreprises.fr.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months of the fiscal year-end; for a December 31 year-end, the deadline is 3 May of the following year (second business day after 1 May). Non-resident companies filing through a French fiscal representative use the same deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Cadre A - Identification (SIREN, NAF/APE, RCS, exercice)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company registration number, principal activity code (ISIC 7310 mapped to NAF), trade registry reference, and opening/closing dates of the fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident company with a French permanent establishment (PE) must use the French SIREN of the registered branch, not the foreign head-office identification; a French fiscal representative must be appointed before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Cadre B - Resultat net comptable (Benéfice / Perte)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting net income or loss for the year before tax reconciliation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE must declare only the profit attributable to the French commercial activity under Article 209 CGI and OECD Article 7 principles; head-office charges are deductible only if supported by French substance documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Ligne CA - Resultat fiscal avant imputation des deficits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after statutory add-backs (non-deductible expenses, fines, excessive directors' fees, non-arm's-length charges) and deductibility adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Add back intra-group charges paid to the foreign parent when no local substance or arm's-length justification exists; transfer pricing documentation must be attached upon request.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Carryforward losses applied in the current year under the annual cap of EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable income exceeding EUR 1,000,000.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE may offset only losses economically borne by the French branch; losses of the foreign head office or other foreign group entities are not eligible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Ligne EL - Base d'imposition au taux réduit de 15%
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: First EUR 42,000 of taxable income eligible for the reduced rate, subject to SME turnover and ownership conditions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The 15% bracket applies to a PE only if the enterprise as a whole meets the turnover (under EUR 10 million) and ownership tests, including the 25% capital held by individuals/SME condition.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Ligne ER - Base d'imposition au taux normal de 25%
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Remaining taxable income taxed at the standard 25% rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident PEs that do not meet SME conditions are taxed at the flat 25% rate on the PE's attributable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Cadre Réductions et crédits d'impôt (CIR, JEI, macénat)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory offsets: CIR R&D credit at 30%, JEI exemption, sponsorship (mecenat) deduction at 60% of sums paid, and other refundable credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credits are granted only in respect of French PE activities; no credit arises for costs incurred abroad or for a shell entity without R&D substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Ligne Impôt dû / Solde à payer
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final corporate tax due after deduction of instalments paid under Form 2571; balance payable by the filing deadline.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Balance must be paid by the appointed fiscal representative or directly from the PE's French bank account; a foreign bank account is not accepted for balance settlement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: automatic 10% surcharge; increased to 40% after a formal notice (mise en demeure); 80% for undisclosed activity (activite occulte). Late payment: 5% penalty plus 0.20% monthly interest (interet de retard); additional 10% penalty on unreported offshore flows.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2052-SD - Compte de resultat (income statement), part of the 'liasse fiscale' filed together with Form 2065 via EFI on impots.gouv.fr.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed simultaneously with Form 2065 (within 3 months of fiscal year-end; for a December 31 year-end: 3 May of the following year).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from services, including TikTok creator management, talent representation commissions, advertising agency services (ISIC 7310), and platform payouts collected on behalf of creators.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a PE, only services attributable to French operations and French-source clients/creators are included; pass-through creator payouts must be reconciled with commission-only revenue to avoid artificial turnover inflation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net turnover after rebates, retrocessions, and reductions; total of merchandise sales and service production.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only the net commission retained by the entity, not gross creator remittances, unless the entity is principal risk-taker; full-risk characterization is determined by French transfer pricing rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net accounting result for the fiscal year before income tax and participation schemes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must equal the PE's annual financial statements filed in France; any head-office allocation must respect the separate-entity approach and supported cost allocations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Same as Form 2065: 10% late filing surcharge, 40% after formal notice, 80% for occult activity; monthly late-payment interest of 0.20%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2571-SD - Instalment payment form for corporate income tax (acomptes d'IS); filed and paid electronically via impots.gouv.fr professional portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Instalments due on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September, and 15 December of the current fiscal year; balance settled with the Form 2065 filing by 3 May (calendar year-end).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated taxable income for the instalment period, computed by reference to the preceding fiscal year's result.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE computes instalments on the basis of the preceding year's French attributable profit; instalments are paid through the fiscal representative's French account.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount due per instalment using the applicable reduced or standard rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident PEs automatically apply the 25% rate unless they can substantiate SME eligibility for the 15% bracket.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-payment of instalments: 5% penalty on the unpaid amount plus 0.20% monthly interest; failure to file: EUR 150 minimum fine per missing return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2561-SD (Releve de dividendes et autres distributions) - annual return of distributions subject to French withholding tax; filed via impots.gouv.fr.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed together with the corporate income tax return (by 3 May for a December 31 fiscal year-end).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, residence address, tax identification number, and tax residency certificate of each non-resident shareholder receiving a distribution.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the residence-State tax authority and Form 5000 when treaty relief or the Parent-Subsidiary Directive exemption is claimed; retain for six years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross amount of dividends and other distributions resolved by the shareholders' meeting.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Gross amount must include the withholding tax borne by the beneficiary; provide a breakdown between cash and in-kind distributions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Taux de retenue à la source appliqué (0% / 12% / 75%)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable withholding rate: 12% domestic statutory, 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive or DTA, 75% for beneficiaries in non-cooperative states (ETNC).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The French paying entity is responsible for collecting and remitting the withholding tax; a zero-rate application requires a prior validated Form 5000 and evidence of the two-year holding period.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Unreported or under-withheld distributions: 5% penalty plus 0.20% monthly interest; the paying company remains personally liable for the entire uncollected withholding tax, with recovery enforceable by tax lien.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 12% under domestic law (CGI Article 119 bis 2); increased to 75% when the beneficiary is domiciled in a non-cooperative state (ETNC); 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for an EU parent holding at least 10% of voting rights for an uninterrupted two-year period; treaty rates generally 0% to 15% depending on the DTA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Non-resident beneficiary must submit Form 5000 accompanied by a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the residence state to the French paying entity or directly to the competent local tax office (DRFIP) before the distribution date; the paying company applies the reduced or zero rate only after the form is validated by the French tax administration; for the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive, evidence of the 10% holding and two-year holding period must be maintained; alternatively, the beneficiary may obtain a refund of excess withholding by filing a reclaim with the DRFIP within the statutory limitation period (generally until 31 December of the second year following the distribution).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: domestic withholding of 33.33% on gross sums paid for the use of patents, copyrights, and similar intellectual property (CGI Article 182 B); treaty relief reduces this to 0% under most French DTAs (e.g., US-France 0% for patent royalties and 5% for commercial/film royalties; Germany-France 0%); interest: domestic statutory withholding abolished by the 2018 Finance Act for arm's-length interest paid to non-residents, 75% remains applicable for payments to beneficiaries in non-cooperative states (ETNC); treaty rates generally 0% to 10%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Full French transfer pricing documentation (Master File and Local File) is mandatory when the gross annual turnover of the French entity, or of the French group head, exceeds EUR 400 million (CGI Article L.13 AA); below this threshold, a simplified documentation obligation applies, upon request of the tax administration, where annual turnover exceeds EUR 50 million and intra-group transactions with a single related party exceed EUR 100,000; a lower standard arm's-length documentation file should nevertheless be prepared for all material intercompany flows.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France does not apply offshore-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) as in the Caribbean or Gulf jurisdictions; instead, substance is enforced through the general anti-abuse rule (abus de droit, Article L.64 of the Livre des Procédures Fiscales), the French tax-residency rule based on effective management (siège de direction effective, Article 209 CGI), DAC6 mandatory disclosure, and the principal purpose test (PPT) in tax treaties. A French SARL acting as a TikTok MCN agency must demonstrate real business substance - local employees, physical presence, French bank accounts, and management decisions taken in France - to prevent recharacterization as a conduit, denial of treaty benefits, and reassessment at the level of the beneficial owners.
